Thomas Andrew `` Tom '' Lehrer ( / ˈlɛrər / ; born April 9 , 1928 ) is a retired American musician , singer - songwriter , satirist , and mathematician . He has lectured on mathematics and musical theater . He is best known for the pithy , humorous songs he recorded in the 1950s and 1960s .

Lehrer has said of his musical career , `` If , after hearing my songs , just one human being is inspired to say something nasty to a friend , or perhaps to strike a loved one , it will all have been worth the while . ''
